description: This file defines a Flutter provider class 'BookingProvider' that manages booking history, handles checkout processes, and interacts with booking and payment services in a ticket booking app.

classes.name: BookingProvider
classes.description: A Flutter ChangeNotifier class managing booking history, processing state, and handling checkout/payment workflows.

methods.name: BookingProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing booking and payment services, and preferences.

methods.name: loadHistory
methods.description: Loads booking history from local storage and notifies listeners.

methods.name: checkout
methods.description: Performs payment for cart items, creates booking entries, persists them, and updates internal state. Returns booking ID if successful.
